title: 道歉、感谢与婉拒
goal: 会根据场合道歉和感谢，回应别人的道歉，礼貌地拒绝推销或邀请。
tips: 道歉加原因更真诚：Sorry I'm late. The traffic was terrible.；正式一点：I apologize for the delay.
回应道歉：No worries. / Don't worry about it. / That's OK. 回应感谢：You're welcome. / No problem. / My pleasure.
拒绝推销：No, thank you. I'm just looking. / I'm not interested, thanks.

exchanges.reply: I'm so sorry. My bus broke down.
exchanges.replyZh: 真的很抱歉，我坐的公交坏了。

exchanges.hear: Sorry, I stepped on your foot.
Thank you so much for dinner.
exchanges.hearZh: 非常感谢你请我吃晚饭。
exchanges.reply: My pleasure. I'm glad you liked it.

exchanges.hear: I fixed your bike for you.
exchanges.hearZh: 我帮你把自行车修好了。
exchanges.reply: Really? Thanks, I owe you one!
exchanges.replyZh: 真的？谢谢，我欠你个人情！

exchanges.hear: Would you like to try our new credit card?
exchanges.hearZh: 您想试试我们的新信用卡吗？
exchanges.reply: No, thank you. I'm not interested.
exchanges.replyZh: 不用了，谢谢，我不感兴趣。

exchanges.hear: Do you want to come out for drinks tonight?
exchanges.reply: Thanks, but I'm really tired. Maybe next time.
exchanges.replyZh: 谢谢，不过我太累了，下次吧。

exchanges.hearZh: 你是不是忘了我的生日？
exchanges.reply: I'm so sorry. It was my fault. Let me buy you dinner.
exchanges.replyZh: 真对不起，是我的错。我请你吃饭吧。

exchanges.reply: That's very kind of you. Thank you.

lines.en: Hey, Emma. I'm so sorry, but I broke your coffee cup.
lines.zh: 嘿，艾玛。真对不起，我把你的咖啡杯打碎了。

lines.en: Oh no! How did that happen?
It was an accident. I knocked it off the desk.
lines.zh: 是个意外，我不小心把它从桌上碰掉了。

lines.en: Don't worry about it. It was just a cheap cup.
lines.zh: 别放在心上，就是个便宜的杯子。

lines.en: Still, it was my fault. Let me buy you a new one.
lines.zh: 不过还是我的错，我给你买个新的吧。

lines.en: That's very kind of you, but you really don't have to.
I insist. Do you like blue?
OK, thank you. Blue is perfect.
